edits.original_en: UK milk tea and plant-based drinks: SDIL exemptions still apply, with changes planned for 2028
edits.original_zh: 英国奶茶与植物基饮品仍适用现行糖税豁免，扩围拟于2028年实施
edits.diagnosis: 标题独立出现时把有条件豁免写成类别整体待遇；中文风险更明显，首段纠正不能替代标题准确。
edits.replacement_en: UK milk tea and plant-based drinks: current SDIL rules and proposed 2028 changes
edits.replacement_zh: 英国奶茶与植物基饮品糖税：现行适用条件与2028年调整方案

edits.original_zh: 含乳清的配方需保留人工复核。
edits.diagnosis: reserved decision／人工复核是审查流程口吻，中文还暗示自动化分类系统。保留具体范围限制，不扩大为所有乳清永远不能判断。
edits.replacement_en: Whey-containing formulations need separate clarification. The policy paper excludes lactose in whey powder, while draft regulation 4C makes its whey exclusions conditional on recombination or reconstitution in the drink.[2][7] This article does not determine which whey-derived lactose would qualify for the proposed allowance. For a whey-containing product, obtain clarification on the applicable provisions before relying on a lactose deduction.
edits.replacement_zh: 含乳清配方的乳糖扣除条件仍需另行确认。政策说明排除乳清粉中的乳糖，草案第4C条则按乳清是否在饮品中重组或复原作出限定。[2][7] 本文不判断哪些乳清来源乳糖可适用拟设扣除额。含乳清产品在采用乳糖扣除前，应先取得对适用条文的明确解释。

edits.original_en: This review has not established an enacted post-consultation expansion or resolved the whey wording; it is not an exhaustive parliamentary or legal-status opinion.
edits.original_zh: 本次核验没有确认到咨询后的已成法扩围文本，也未解决乳清措辞差异，不构成穷尽议会记录的法律状态意见。
edits.diagnosis: 研究日记替代读者结论；没找到成法不能表述为证明无成法。整段改为归属具体文件的有限主张。
edits.replacement_en: HMRC’s July 2026 policy paper presents the changes as proposals and says final guidance will follow.[2] For a commercial decision, confirm the applicable enacted provisions, commencement date and HMRC guidance. Whey-related allowance eligibility is outside the scope of this article.
edits.replacement_zh: HMRC于2026年7月公布的政策文件说明了调整方案，并表示将另行发布最终指引。[2] 作出商业决定时，应确认适用的已通过条文、生效日期和HMRC指引；本文不判定含乳清配方的乳糖扣除资格。

edits.original_en: Sugared plant-milk blend added to animal milk
edits.original_zh: 含糖植物乳组合加入动物乳
edits.diagnosis: Sugared可读成另行加糖，blend／组合又暗示多植物混合；原文的关键是乳替代饮料自带糖加入动物乳也按添加糖处理。
edits.replacement_en: Plant-based milk substitute containing sugars, mixed with plain animal milk | The policy treats sugars contributed by the milk substitute as added sugars; assess the sugar threshold and any eligible lactose allowance.[2]
edits.replacement_zh: 含糖的植物乳替代饮料与纯动物乳混合 | 政策将乳替代饮料带入的糖视为添加糖；还需判断糖含量门槛及符合条件的乳糖扣除额。[2]

edits.original_en: The immediate deliverable is a traceable record of the product as supplied and consumed.
edits.original_zh: 眼下最有用的准备，是让供应状态、饮用状态和配方组成可以追溯。
edits.diagnosis: 英文deliverable像内部任务，中文抽象；改为具体资料内容。
edits.replacement_en: Keep the recipe version, supply format and preparation instructions together in one product file. The blank worksheet follows HMRC’s proposed evidence categories; it is not an official form.[2]
edits.replacement_zh: 将配方版本、销售形态和调制说明归入同一份成品资料。下方空白表参考HMRC拟采用的证据类别编制，并非官方申报表。[2]

edits.original_en: This article makes no forecast for stevia demand.
edits.diagnosis: 供应链需求预测并非本页问题，反复否认显得防御；保留必要食品使用与税务范围区别即可。
edits.replacement_en: HMRC’s current SDIL guidance lists stevia among sugar replacements rather than sugars.[4] This tax treatment does not establish permitted food uses or the performance of a finished recipe.
edits.replacement_zh: HMRC现行SDIL指南将甜菊列为糖替代物，而非糖。[4] 这一税务分类不等于对具体食品用途的许可，也不能证明成品配方的表现。

acceptance: Apply E1-E5, retain supported scope and dates, re-read changed bilingual text and both worksheets; then issue an actual new PASS if no substantive misleading issue remains.
